relations.rationale: Kira arriving after Ivo suggests Ivo was ahead in arrival order, but arrival order does not determine race finish order.
Arrival time before an event has no bearing on race finishing order.
Carrying boxes of gears wrapped in cloth has no bearing on who finished a race ahead of whom.
Both carrying boxes of gears does not imply anything about relative robot speeds.
Leo driving the minibus is unrelated to Kira's hopes about her robot's balance.
Leo driving the minibus has no bearing on the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.

Preparation the night before suggests better performance, supporting that Nell finished ahead of Ivo, though not conclusively.
Nell's preparation activities have no bearing on the color of Noor's robot.
Being determined and ready supports the likelihood of performing well, which could support finishing ahead of Ivo.
Nell's determination for the challenge is unrelated to Leo helping newer members solder wires.

The start of a maze task has no bearing on relative heights of Ivo and Nell.
